outlook.discussion: 1. Western Central Pacific: Showers and thunderstorms are becoming more organized in association with a broad area of low pressure located near the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston Atoll. Environmental conditions appear conducive for development over the next few days, and a tropical depression could form during the early part of next week while the system moves east-northeastward at 10 to 15 mph. By the middle of next week, however, strong upper-level winds should limit any additional development. Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. Formatio
